description: TOS ca 1969 and served in South Vietnam; converted to AH-1S Modernized ca 1981 and with 4th Armored Cavalry Regiment in Germany by August 1988; redesignated AH-1F ca September 1988; stored at Fort Drum then displayed at Fort McCoy Wisconsin; restored using the tail boom of 68-17101 so this airframe is a composite; on display at American Legion Post 237 Footville by December 2002
